name: Screen/Server Detail — Capture — Start capture (Invalid filter)

children.name: Warning Banner
texts: Caution: network packet captures contain real player data
•  Player IP addresses and port numbers
•  Network timing and game protocol messages
•  For some games, in-band credentials (passwords, tokens, session keys)
Captures are not redacted or sanitized. Access is restricted to administrators only. Captures are automatically deleted after the configured retention window (currently 24 hours).

children.name: mDesc
children.text: Records raw network traffic on this server's advertised ports (or a custom filter) for later download.

children.name: text
children.text: Optional. Use pcap-filter syntax (e.g. "tcp port 8080", "host 192.168.1.5"). Leave blank to capture only on this server's game ports.

children.name: Filter Error
children.text: Invalid BPF syntax: syntax error at position 12 (invalid token 'foo')

children.name: text
children.text: How long the capture runs before auto-stopping. Range 1–3600 seconds.

children.name: text
children.text: Maximum file size. Capture stops when reached. Cluster max: 5 GB.

children.name: text
children.text: How long the capture is retained before auto-delete. Cluster allows up to 24 hours.
